officialAcquisition.indexPin: Use strongest collision-resistant hash available in authenticated Release (SHA512 preferred, SHA256 minimum); fetch corresponding by-hash or verify exact signed size/hash before parse
officialAcquisition.packageURLs: exact origin plus safe Filename from authenticated arm64/all package stanza; retain complete manifest and cache for offline replay

nativeProbePolicy.parentAndChildIdentityChecks: Use actual V3 selected parent Image plus child ImageManifestDescriptor, with exact Config.Image and platform.
isolation: private bounded tmpfs only; fixed readonly owned input snapshots; no repository/HOME/socket/credentials/writable host mounts
operations: Read/hash exact apt/gpgv/dpkg/tool paths, base package status and Ubuntu archive keyring. No install or apt update.

After bounded host acquisition, verify signatures using the captured trusted base keyring/tool identities; offline dependency resolution against authenticated indexes and captured base status, with no package transfer.
Verify selected signer fingerprint, signed date/suite/component/architecture and strongest signed index size/hash. Reject missing or changed authority.
All-outcome exact owned container/group/temp cleanup; retained immutable evidence/package lock allowed within fixed owned directory.

networkPolicy: Only bounded host-side HTTPS to exact selected official Ubuntu origins and safe authenticated index paths; no credentials, no unselected redirects or retries. Containers remain network-none.
notSelected: Shared/global package installs or apt state changes
